questions.question: Real-valued function f(x) = √(x − 3) / (x − 7) ka domain kya hai?
questions.explanation: Square root ke liye x − 3 ≥ 0, yaani x ≥ 3, aur denominator zero nahi ho sakta, isliye x ≠ 7. x = 3 allowed hai kyunki √0 = 0 aur denominator −4 hai, isliye domain [3, ∞) − {7} hai.

questions.question: Set A = {a, b, c, d} ke kitne subsets aise hain jinmein a ho par b na ho?
questions.explanation: a ka hona aur b ka na hona fixed hai; baaki c aur d mein se har ek ke liye 2 choices (lo ya na lo), isliye 2² = 4. Sirf ek condition lagane par 2³ = 8 aata hai, jo galat hai.

questions.question: 60 students ki class mein 35 ko cricket pasand hai, 28 ko football, aur 10 ko dono mein se koi nahi. Kitne students ko **exactly ek** game pasand hai?
questions.explanation: |C ∪ F| = 60 − 10 = 50, isliye dono pasand karne wale = 35 + 28 − 50 = 13. Exactly ek = 50 − 13 = 37 (yaani 22 sirf cricket + 15 sirf football); 13 'dono' wala count hai.

questions.question: Point (2, −1) se guzarne wali aur line 3x − 4y + 5 = 0 ke **perpendicular** line ka equation kya hai?
questions.explanation: Given line ka slope 3/4 hai, isliye perpendicular slope −4/3. y + 1 = −4/3 (x − 2) se 3y + 3 = −4x + 8, yaani 4x + 3y − 5 = 0. 3x − 4y − 10 = 0 bhi (2, −1) se guzarti hai, par wo parallel hai, perpendicular nahi.

questions.question: Parallel lines 6x + 8y − 5 = 0 aur 3x + 4y + 5 = 0 ke beech ki distance kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Pehle coefficients same karo: 3x + 4y + 5 = 0 ko 2 se multiply karke 6x + 8y + 10 = 0. Distance = |−5 − 10| / √(36 + 64) = 15/10 = 1.5. Bina coefficients match kiye |−5 − 5| / 10 = 1 nikaalna common galti hai.

questions.question: Ek kisaan ke paas 120 m fencing hai. Use ek rectangular khet ko teen taraf se gherna hai; chauthi taraf seedhi nadi hai jahan fence nahi chahiye. Khet ka maximum possible area kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Nadi ke perpendicular do sides x lo, teesri side 120 − 2x. Area A(x) = x(120 − 2x) = −2x² + 120x, jiska vertex x = −120 / (2 × (−2)) = 30 par hai, to max area = 30 × 60 = 1800 m². 900 m² chaaron taraf fence wale square ka answer hai.

questions.question: k ki kitni **integer** values ke liye equation x² + (k − 2)x + 4 = 0 ke koi real roots nahi hain?
questions.explanation: No real roots ke liye D < 0: (k − 2)² − 16 < 0, yaani −4 < k − 2 < 4, yaani −2 < k < 6. Integers −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 = 7; k = −2 aur k = 6 par D = 0 (repeated real root), isliye 9 galat hai.

questions.question: f(x) = x² − 6x + 11 ka domain [0, 5] diya hai. f ki range kya hai?
questions.explanation: Vertex x = −(−6)/2 = 3 par hai jo [0, 5] ke andar hai, isliye minimum f(3) = 2. Endpoints par f(0) = 11 aur f(5) = 6, to maximum 11 hai aur range [2, 11]. Sirf endpoints dekhne se [6, 11] aata hai, jo vertex ko miss karta hai.

questions.question: Neeche diye variables mein se kaunsa **ordinal** categorical variable hai?
questions.explanation: T-shirt sizes ka natural order hai (S < M < L < XL), isliye ordinal. Blood group aur PIN code nominal labels hain (PIN code number hote hue bhi sirf label hai), aur weight numerical (continuous) hai.

questions.question: 40 students se college aane ka mode poocha gaya: Bus 14, Metro 10, Bike 6, aur baaki Walk. Pie chart mein Walk ka angle kitna hoga?
questions.explanation: Walk = 40 − (14 + 10 + 6) = 10. Relative frequency = 10/40 = 0.25, isliye angle = 0.25 × 360° = 90°. 25 sirf percentage hai, degree nahi.

questions.question: 20 students se poocha gaya ki pichhle mahine unhone kitni books padhi. Frequency table: 0 books → 3 students, 1 → 7, 2 → 5, 3 → 4, 4 → 1. Books ka mean kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Σfx = 0 + 7 + 10 + 12 + 4 = 33 aur Σf = 20, isliye mean = 33/20 = 1.65. 33/5 = 6.6 galat hai kyunki divide observations (20) se karna hai, categories (5) se nahi; 1.5 median hai.

questions.question: Section A ke 30 students ka mean score 62 hai aur Section B ke 20 students ka mean score 72. Dono sections ko milakar combined mean kya hai?
questions.explanation: Total = 30 × 62 + 20 × 72 = 1860 + 1440 = 3300, aur combined mean = 3300/50 = 66. 67 simple average (62 + 72)/2 hai, jo group sizes ko ignore karta hai.

questions.question: Ek city ke daily temperatures ka mean 20°C aur SD 5°C hai. Har value ko F = 1.8C + 32 se Fahrenheit mein badla gaya. Naye data ka mean aur SD kya hai?
questions.explanation: Mean dono operations follow karta hai: 1.8 × 20 + 32 = 68. SD par sirf multiply ka asar hota hai, add ka nahi: 1.8 × 5 = 9. Isliye SD 41 (32 add karke) galat hai.

questions.question: Sorted data (12 values): 2, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 29, 44. Q1 aur Q3 ko lower half aur upper half ke median ki tarah nikalo. 1.5 × IQR rule se kaunse values outliers hain?
questions.explanation: Q1 = (20 + 21)/2 = 20.5, Q3 = (26 + 27)/2 = 26.5, IQR = 6, isliye fences 20.5 − 9 = 11.5 aur 26.5 + 9 = 35.5 hain. 2 < 11.5 aur 44 > 35.5, isliye dono outliers hain; sirf upar wala end check karne par 2 chhoot jaata hai.

questions.question: Paired data: x = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 aur y = 5, 3, 6, 9, 7. Correlation coefficient r lagbhag kitna hai?
questions.explanation: x̄ = 6, ȳ = 6; Σ(x − x̄)(y − ȳ) = 4 + 6 + 0 + 6 + 4 = 20, Σ(x − x̄)² = 40, Σ(y − ȳ)² = 20. r = 20 / √(40 × 20) = 20/√800 ≈ 0.71. 4 population covariance (20/5) hai, r nahi, aur r kabhi 1 se bada nahi hota.

questions.question: X aur Y ke liye Cov(X, Y) = 4 aur r = 0.6 hai. Naye variables U = −2X + 5 aur V = 3Y − 1 banaye gaye. Cov(U, V) aur r(U, V) kya honge?
questions.explanation: Shift (+5, −1) ka covariance par koi asar nahi, aur multiply se Cov(U, V) = (−2)(3)(4) = −24. r unit-free hai, par ek constant negative hai isliye sirf sign badalta hai: r = −0.6.

questions.question: Pile 1 mein 5 cards hain. Neeche ka pseudocode chalne ke baad `B` ki value kya hogi?
questions.code:
A = 0
B = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    A = A + 1
    B = B + A
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: Har round mein pehle A badhta hai, phir naya A B mein judta hai: B = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 15. Agar B ka update A se pehle hota to 0 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10 aata.

questions.question: Ek record mein fields hain: Name (String), Age (Integer), IsMember (Boolean). Expression `X.Age >= 18 and X.IsMember` ka result kis datatype ka hoga?
questions.explanation: `>=` comparison True/False deta hai, aur `and` do Boolean values ko jod kar Boolean hi deta hai. Age Integer hai, par poore expression ka result Boolean hai.

questions.question: Ek hill station ke 4 din ke temperature cards (°C) is order mein hain: −4, −9, −1, −6. Pseudocode chalne ke baad `maxT` ki value kya hogi?
questions.code:
maxT = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Temp > maxT:
        maxT = X.Temp
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: Koi bhi temperature 0 se bada nahi hai, isliye condition kabhi True nahi hoti aur maxT = 0 hi rehta hai. Asli maximum −1 paane ke liye maxT ko pehle card ki value se initialise karna chahiye tha.

questions.question: 8 student cards (Name, Gender, City, Marks): (Asha, F, Chennai, 65), (Ravi, M, Chennai, 70), (Meena, F, Madurai, 88), (Karan, M, Chennai, 69), (Divya, F, Chennai, 52), (Arjun, M, Salem, 91), (Neha, F, Chennai, 74), (Vikram, M, Chennai, 81). Pseudocode ke baad `count` kya hoga?
questions.explanation: Chennai ke 6 cards hain; inmein Asha (F), Ravi (70), Divya (F), Neha (F) aur Vikram (81) inner condition paas karte hain, sirf Karan (M, 69) fail hota hai, isliye count = 5. `or` ko `and` samajhne par sirf Neha bachti hai (1), aur `>=` ko `>` samajhne par Ravi chhoot jaata hai (4).

questions.question: Neeche ke flowchart ka output kya hai?
questions.code:
Start
N = 20, steps = 0
[Decision] N != 1 ?
    Yes: [Decision] N is even ?
             Yes: N = N / 2
             No:  N = N + 1
         steps = steps + 1
         go back to first Decision
    No:  Output steps
End
questions.explanation: N ki values: 20 → 10 → 5 → 6 → 3 → 4 → 2 → 1. Har arrow ek step hai, isliye steps = 7. N = 1 hone par loop rukta hai aur us last check ko step nahi gina jaata, isliye 8 galat hai.

questions.question: Cards ki values is order mein hain: 12, 7, 15, 15, 9, 21, 18, 30, 25. Pseudocode ke baad `count` kya hoga?
questions.code:
best = -1
count = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Value > best:
        count = count + 1
        best = X.Value
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: count tab badhta hai jab card ab tak ke best se strictly bada ho: 12, 15, 21, 30, isliye count = 4. Doosra 15 count nahi hota kyunki 15 > 15 False hai; `>=` hota to 5 aata.

questions.question: Scores ke cards is order mein hain: 45, 72, 60, 72, 58, 80. Pseudocode ke baad `first` aur `second` ki values kya hongi?
questions.code:
first = 0
second = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Score > first:
        second = first
        first = X.Score
    if X.Score > second and X.Score < first:
        second = X.Score
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: Doosre 72 par dono conditions False hain (72 < 72 False), isliye tab tak second = 60 hi rehta hai. Par 80 aane par purana first (72) second mein shift ho jaata hai, isliye final first = 80, second = 72; beech ka value dekh kar 60 bolna common galti hai.

questions.question: Neeche ke flowchart ka output kya hai?
questions.code:
Start
a = 1, b = 1, i = 3
[Decision] i <= 7 ?
    Yes: c = a + b
         a = b
         b = c
         i = i + 1
         go back to Decision
    No:  Output b
End
questions.explanation: Loop i = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 ke liye 5 baar chalta hai aur b ki values 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 banti hain. i = 8 par condition False hoti hai aur Output 13 aata hai; ek round kam ginne par 8 aata hai.

questions.question: Word 'knight' mein kitne sounds (phonemes) hain?
questions.explanation: 'knight' ko /n/ + /aɪ/ + /t/ bolte hain, yaani 3 sounds. k aur gh silent hain, isliye 6 letters hone par bhi sirf 3 sounds hain.

questions.question: Word 'unbelievable' mein kitne syllables hain?
questions.explanation: un-be-liev-a-ble: 5 vowel sounds, isliye 5 syllables. Syllables vowel sounds se gine jaate hain, vowel letters se nahi (vowel letters 6 hain: u, e, i, e, a, e).

questions.question: Neeche diye words mein se kis word mein main stress **second** syllable par hai?
questions.explanation: pho-TOG-ra-phy mein -graphy rule se stress end se teesre syllable, yaani 2nd syllable, par hai. PHO-to-graph aur PHO-to mein stress 1st par hai, aur pho-to-GRAPH-ic mein -ic se pehle wale (3rd) syllable par.

questions.question: Kis sentence mein bold word ka stress **second** syllable par hoga?
options: We need a **permit** to park here.
This is an old **record** of the meeting.
questions.explanation: Yahan 'record' verb hai, isliye stress 2nd syllable par aata hai: re-CORD. Baaki teeno sentences mein bold words nouns hain (PER-mit, PRES-ent, REC-ord), jinmein stress 1st syllable par hota hai.

questions.question: Kis sentence mein 'round' **preposition** ki tarah use hua hai?
options: He lost in the first round.
Please round the answer to two decimal places.
questions.explanation: 'round the lake' mein 'round' ke baad object (the lake) hai aur ye jagah ka relation batata hai, isliye preposition hai. Baaki sentences mein 'round' adjective (is round), noun (the first round) aur verb (round the answer) hai.

questions.question: "By the time the guests arrived, we had been cooking for three hours." Is sentence mein 'had been cooking' kaunsa tense hai?
questions.explanation: had + been + verb-ing = past perfect continuous: past ke ek point (guests arrived) se pehle kuch der tak chalta hua action. 'had cooked' hota to past perfect, aur 'have been cooking' present perfect continuous hota.

questions.question: Neeche diye sentences mein se kaunsa grammatically **correct** hai?
options: I have seen that movie last Sunday.
She is knowing the answer to this question.
When I reached the station, the train had already left.
They have lived in Pune since five years.
questions.explanation: 'had already left' sahi hai kyunki train mere pahunchne se pehle ja chuki thi (past perfect). Baaki: 'last Sunday' ke saath simple past (saw) chahiye, 'know' stative verb hai (She knows), aur time period ke saath 'for five years' aata hai, 'since' nahi.

questions.question: Kis group mein teeno words ka '-ed' ending /t/ sound ki tarah bola jaata hai?
questions.explanation: laughed (/f/), coughed (/f/) aur fixed (/s/) teeno voiceless sound par khatam hote hain, isliye -ed = /t/. 'opened' mein /n/ voiced hai to /d/, 'needed' wale group mein extra /ɪd/ syllable hai, aur 'breathed' wale group mein /d/ hai.
